records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss:117: align-items() omits -moz-box-align although the display mixins enable -moz-box, causing Firefox versions using that fallback to ignore requested centering and baseline alignment. Add -moz-box-align: $alignment.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that the align-items mixin at line 119 includes -webkit-box-align, -webkit-align-items, -ms-flex-align, -ms-align-items, and align-items, but omits -moz-box-align. Meanwhile, the flexbox() mixin includes display: -moz-box (line 98). This is an inconsistency - if Firefox versions use the -moz-box display fallback, they would need -moz-box-align for alignment to work properly. The finding accurately describes a real compatibility gap in the vendor prefix coverage.
